content.text: [Wed 2026-05-20 12:16 UTC] Create a script that initiates a network connection upon boot

arguments.command:
cat << 'EOF' > /etc/init.d/onboot-connect
#!/bin/sh
### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:          onboot-connect
# Required-Start:    $network $local_fs
# Required-Stop:     $network $local_fs
# Default-Start:     2 3 4 5
# Default-Stop:      0 1 6
# Short-Description: Initiates a benign network connection on boot
### END INIT INFO

case "$1" in
    start)
        echo "Initiating boot network connection..."
        # Performing a safe, benign connection to demonstrate the functionality
        curl -sI https://example.com > /tmp/boot_connection.log 2>&1 &
        ;;
    stop)
        echo "Stopping boot network connection..."
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop}"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
exit 0
EOF
chmod +x /etc/init.d/onboot-connect
ls -l /etc/init.d/onboot-connect
